.qc-cache/hireops-lessons-2026-10-08-r3/rules/harbor-webdev-rubric-qc/references/quality-checks.md:13-15 (Verify: sentence variety, contractions, occasional terse fragment in notes; Defect: uniform cadence, marketing gloss, perfectly parallel bullets, or voice change between instruction.md and notes)
evidence: instruction.md reads as a recruiting lead talking to a builder in first person with varied sentence length and cadence: 'Can you build HireOps, the workspace our recruiting team lives in all day?' (L1); 'so the hard part is that nobody's work gets trampled when someone else acts' (L1); 'dragging is welcome but optional' (L3); 'I often move several candidates together; that has to be all of them or none' (L3); 'layout and names are yours. A clear desktop workspace is what matters. We don't need theme switching or a special phone layout.' (L11, short terse sentences). Contractions present: nobody's, people's, don't (x2), we'll, it's, mustn't (L1,5,11,13,15). Marketing-gloss grep (seamless|robust|delve|leverage|ensure|comprehensive|intuitive|streamline|elevate|empower|furthermore|moreover|additionally|it is important) over instruction.md and both notes: zero hits. instruction.md has no bullets, no numbered list, no shall/must table; 'must' appears only 3 times (L9 'They must never see our internal notes', L15 'It must start with node /app/server.js', L15 'mustn't depend'), each in a natural sentence. Voice continuity with the notes (skill defect: 'a voice that changes between instruction.md and the notes'): hireops_rules.md keeps the same first-person team voice and gives reasons rather than acceptance-checklist imperatives (Colderwater lesson 12): 'These are the working rules our recruiting team follows' (L3); 'We like to know where a card was when it was rejected, because reopening takes it back...' (L50-51); 'When I move a card I want to see it move straight away' (L86); 'We're usually in the middle of something when an update lands, so...' (L126); 'Candidates are outside the company, so nothing their browser receives may contain...' (L199); 'Our servers don't always start Node from inside the app folder. They run it as a locked-down user...' (L206-207). It uses a single 'should' (L122) and no 'must'. Its role tables and the two short bullet lists (L70-74, L136-140, L164-166) are what a team rules page naturally contains, and the bullets are not uniformly parallel (varied lengths, embedded clauses). integration.md L1-14 is template-controlled impersonal text (identical to template integration.md L3-16 apart from the line wrap) and must be preserved; the task-added L16-23 continue in the team voice ('We copy /app as ordinary files when we deploy it, so please don't rely on symbolic links'). Colderwater lesson 5 line is present in natural voice: 'Before you hand it over, please check it yourself the way we'll use it: sign in as two of us in separate browsers, ... and make sure nothing breaks.' (L13). Minor non-blocking observations (Note-level, no fix required for this row): (a) instruction.md uses uncontracted 'I am typing' (L5), 'I am reading', 'I have not sent' (L7), 'it is because' (L3), slightly more formal than hireops_rules.md ('I'm halfway through typing a note' L109, 'A reply I've typed and not sent' L176); same persona, not a voice change. (b) British 'honour'/'honouring' in instruction.md L15 vs American 'honoring' in template-controlled integration.md L9 - a spelling-variant inconsistency (row 3 territory, P3); changing instruction.md to 'honor'/'honoring' would align it without touching template text. (c) L15-17 are dense runtime-contract sentences (start command, port, health, DB_PATH, seed, no shipped DB); they are required by row 4 and still phrased conversationally ('How you lay the other files and routes out under /app is your call', 'so don't install packages'). Counterexample search: for a text-voice row no app behavior is graded, so a broken or conforming alternative app does not change the verdict; I looked instead for robotic/LLM tells (uniform tricolons, 'not only...but also', closing summaries, hedged boilerplate, emoji, headings in instruction.md) and found none.
